text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're running in the Make Debut.
Yeah, you're running in the Make Debut.

text_block_list.text:
"She was in great shape. With her natural 
talent as well, we can expect quite a lot 
from her debut race."

The race I proposed was a 1800m turf. It 
seemed nearly optimal for Neo Universe, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...A dissonance in the universe. If she 
runs—

A cold light flashes in her eyes. It's as 
if she's measuring something at an 
astonishing speed...

I don't know why she's on guard to this 
extent. However, taking her motivation 
into consideration, I decided to change 
the race she's running in.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
1,600m... It is a "divergence" from Neo 
Universe's aether.

The race chosen was a turf 1,600m mile. 
Granted, 1,800m would probably suit her a 
bit better, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still—even if we are "divergent," we can 
still "synchronize."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Crossing "Vallis Menelaus," only then will 
we establish a 『connection』...

Neo Universe looked around with a smile. 
She didn't converse much with the other 
Umamusume yet. And yet...

If we run, we might be able to understand 
each other. Will our first contact be a 
success?
